log.text: M15 barrier: a fresh supply zone 4566.07 to 4586.43, an engulf (EG) zone: the last up candle before a close below its low.
Price left the barrier and came back to it (visit 8). Its confirmation is read on M1. The barrier is with the H1 direction (sell).
M1 CF: a QM (BO Structure) sell, a candle closed below 4577.76. A sell limit rests at that level for the pullback.

Price pulled back to the level: sell 4577.76, stop 4580.51 ($0.30 past the extreme 4580.21 made at the barrier, risk $2.75), target 4575.01 (1R: the replay's own choice, the method names no fixed target here).
M30 BO sell: a candle closed below 4534.74.
M30 turned buy: its newest break (3 candles a side) is the other way, so the sell BO gives no more entries; the VR level is bought on the retest.
M15 VR: the first BO Structure against the BO, through 4521.30 (its extreme 4488.63).
After the touch, a new M15 CF buy (a BO Structure, a candle closed above 4535.96): buy 4555.29 at its close, stop 4491.63 (past the CF box low 4491.93), target the last high 4559.36 (0.1R).
